title: Kafka发送确认：消息发出后，怎样才算发送成功？
scope: Producer observed evidence: send return vs confirmed metadata vs final delivery timeout. Compare actual log records, original batch retries, application new producer session and deterministic synchronous serialization failure. No replica or consumer exactly-once survey.
example: Fictional notification event E01/order7042 on orders P0. Three independent branches reset to an empty partition; producer A application send-1 and producer B new application send-2 retain the same eventId.
question: 发送方怎样判断调用返回、发送成功证据和结果未知？
